name: Malbek Contrax
description_en:
This catalogue’s Malbek Contrax entry now points to a site presenting Malbek CLM within a wider commercial-intelligence platform. CLM manages the agreement lifecycle; Malbek AI, BusinessIQ, Klix and Marketplace have distinct roles in analysis, clickwrap and connectivity.

The current product centres on configurable requests, drafting, approvals and contract information shared across legal, sales, procurement and finance. This profile describes that current scope without assuming every module belongs to a historical Contrax purchase.
description_zh:
目录中的 Malbek Contrax 条目当前指向以 Malbek CLM 为核心的商业智能平台。CLM 管理协议生命周期，Malbek AI、BusinessIQ、Klix 和 Marketplace 分别承担分析、点击同意及连接等不同职责。

当前产品围绕可配置申请、起草、审批及跨法务、销售、采购、财务共享的合同信息展开。本文介绍当前范围，不假定历史 Contrax 采购包含全部模块。

core_features.explanation_en: Route by rules, value or risk, including parallel reviews and escalation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按规则、金额或风险路由，支持并行审阅和升级处理。

core_features.name_zh: 批准条款与 AI 规则
core_features.explanation_en: Use preferred wording and playbooks when reviewing deviations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 审阅偏差时使用首选措辞和规则。

core_features.explanation_en: Price users, user types, modules and integration connectors separately in a quote.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在报价中分别核对用户、用户类型、模块及集成连接器。

use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation scenario, not observed customer adoption.

sources.research_notes_en: Read rule/value/risk workflows, parallel review, escalation, templates and playbook-based redlining.

sources.title: Plans - Malbek
sources.research_notes_en: Read user-type/user/module/connector quote factors, variable integration charges, scoped implementation and monthly training terms.

official_check.scope: Public official pages read and bilingual draft cross-checked; no account, purchase, execution, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: A procurement workflow can collect agreement type, vendor and scope, generate the appropriate template and queue reviewers. The CLM page describes rules based on value or risk, parallel approvals, notifications and escalation. Test a change to contract value after intake and a missing approver. The website’s narrated scenario is product illustration, not a customer deployment or a test completed for this profile.
sections.zh: 采购流程可收集协议类型、供应商和范围，生成相应模板并安排审阅人。CLM 页描述按金额或风险规则、并行审批、通知和升级处理。可测试申请后金额变化及审批人缺失。网站叙述场景属于产品示例，不是本文已验证的客户部署或测试。

sections.title_en: Separate CLM, portfolio intelligence and clickwrap
sections.title_zh: 区分 CLM、组合智能及点击同意
sections.en: The site lists CLM, Malbek AI, BusinessIQ, Klix and Marketplace as modules. A contract workflow and a clickwrap acceptance flow are not the same purchase or interaction. BusinessIQ is presented as portfolio-level commercial intelligence, while Marketplace connects enterprise applications. Ask which modules and data are included before using a demonstration as a specification.
sections.zh: 网站把 CLM、Malbek AI、BusinessIQ、Klix 和 Marketplace 列为模块。合同流程与点击接受流程，采购和交互均不同。BusinessIQ 面向组合层商业智能，Marketplace 用于连接企业应用。把演示当作规格前，应确认实际包含的模块和数据范围。

sections.title_en: Get user-type and connector detail in the quote
sections.title_zh: 在报价中明确用户类型和连接器
sections.en: The official pricing page bases quotes on user types, number of users, modules and connections. Some integrations are included and others cost extra. Implementation is tailored to the business; training and support are described separately, including monthly training without an additional fee. No numeric subscription or implementation amount was verified. Request recurring and initial charges with the exact connector and module list.
sections.zh: 官方按用户类型、数量、模块及连接报价，部分集成包含、部分另收费。实施按业务需求配置，培训支持另有说明，其中每月培训标为不额外收费。未核实订阅及实施金额，应要求按具体连接器和模块清单分别列出持续及首次费用。

sections.en: Malbek describes business-user configurability and no-code connections. A team still needs contract owners, approved language, fields and authority rules. Review the actual document and data references behind AI suggestions, then check an export and a rejected approval. An integration logo does not prove a custom mapping or retry path. This hosted-platform research verified no self-hosted package, licence agreement, recovery targets or AI accuracy.
sections.zh: Malbek 介绍业务用户配置和无代码连接，但团队仍需维护合同负责人、批准措辞、字段和授权规则。应检查 AI 建议背后的文档及数据引用，并核对一次导出和拒绝审批。集成 Logo 不证明自定义映射或重试路径可用。本文研究托管平台，未核实自托管包、许可合同、恢复目标或 AI 准确率。

sections.title_en: Use it for cross-team contract operations
sections.en: The platform is relevant when procurement, legal and revenue teams share a maintained contracting process and need post-signature visibility. A single-file signing task may not justify modules and integration work. Historical Contrax naming, current order-form SKUs and the boundaries between CLM and BusinessIQ should be confirmed before migration. No customer retention, savings or implementation-time claims were independently tested.
sections.zh: 采购、法务和收入团队共享持续维护的合同流程，并需要签后可见性时，平台值得评估。单文件签署任务可能不值得承担模块及集成工作。迁移前应确认历史 Contrax 名称、当前订单 SKU，以及 CLM 与 BusinessIQ 的边界。本文未独立测试留存、节省或实施时间主张。
